scope: Review of all older monthly CSVs, with current-month regression comparisons; canonical source coverage December 2023 through September 2026.
parser_changes: Extract PDF words separately by font so overlapping description-layer spaces cannot split amount digits.
Infer the left edge of repeated column alignments instead of averaging starts and cutting off slightly offset descriptions.
Use one shared row grammar and amount pattern for metadata, payload extraction, and trailing-amount removal.
Accept omitted source or status columns and preserve their missing values as empty strings.
Recognize payment dates touching the status column without a space.
Keep a payment row open for geometrically aligned continuation lines; preserve wrapped payees and descriptions after the amount.
Stop merging letter runs when coordinates move back to a preceding column on a continuation line.
Separate adjacent reporting months into monthly artifact sets; preserve overlapping source payments for downstream deduplication.
Remove the runtime model import cycle from the coordinate splitter.
Ignore wrapped status-column text while retaining payee and description continuations beneath the same payment row.

validation.reconciliation: Every rebuilt CSV total including voids matches its printed accounts-payable total.
validation.fallback_scope: All 10,639 final archived rows were reparsed with the text-only name heuristic entry point patched to raise.
validation.existing_accuracy_thresholds: Unchanged: June payees 158/162 matches; top payees 31/31 matches. June/July deduplicated totals retain their exact existing assertions.
validation.visual_review: Inspected representative original pages for amount-font overlap, column jitter, missing glyphs, missing metadata columns, status overlap, and 23 residual anomaly flags; the wrapped sheriff/coroner name found during visual review is restored.
validation.tests: PASS: python -m unittest discover -s tests; 158 tests in 78.450 seconds. No accuracy thresholds lowered.

corrected_fixture_assertion.evidence: Canonical 2025-08-19 Agenda Packet.pdf page 21 explicitly lists voided EFTs 3342, 3343, and 3344 dated June 30 in the July register. They were absent from the prior combined chunk fixture.
corrected_fixture_assertion.assertions: Retain the original 17 EFTs in the June report; also require all three July-reported voids. Exact deduplicated monthly dollar totals are unchanged.

validation.archive_audit: PASS: 34 of 34 monthly registers from December 2023 through September 2026, with no missing months; quarterly financial-report coverage unchanged and complete.
validation.saved_artifact_reproduction: PASS: all 34 archived CSVs reproduce byte-for-byte from their saved chunks without the text-only heuristic fallback; every monthly amount matches the printed source total; all 108 refreshed artifact hashes verified.
validation.archive_builder: PASS: scripts/build_register_archive.sh on a bounded canonical-originals tree containing 2025-08-19 Agenda Packet.pdf. Both monthly CSVs and chunk JSON match the refreshed archive byte-for-byte.
validation.whitespace: PASS: git diff --check on the edited parser, documentation, and test files.

source_limitations.evidence: The original contains 313 check rows including two voids, plus 33 EFT rows. Its summary also adds two voids to the count. The dollar total matches the itemized rows.
All 302 numbered payment rows are retained. Their dollar total matches the printed AP total; the printed transaction count is one lower.
Letter gaps are visible in the rendered source PDF and absent from its extracted character layer. Names are retained as printed; cross-month similarities are not used to fabricate missing letters.
The existing source discrepancy remains: itemized Open/Reconciled subtotals differ from the printed status subtotals, while total row count and AP amount reconcile.

source_limitations.handling: Absent row statuses remain blank; void markers in the printed rows remain available.
